balls.text: Shedge finishes the innings with a boundary! Full toss, angling into off. Shedge shuffles across and muscles it between long on and deep mid wicket. Starc put in a slide to his right but his foot was touching the cushion as he made contact. PBKS end with 210!
another dipping wide full toss. Shreyas cannot time it the way he wants and scuffs it down the ground to long off
full toss outside off. Shedge a little late on this and cloths it down the ground to long off
another slower ball and this, despite being a full toss, dips late. Shedge tries to fetch it from outside off but only connects with fresh air
dipping wide yorker and Shedge cannot quite get his shot away. Tries the sweep, having shuffled across, but is too early on it. Off the pad and towards the bowler
full and wide outside off. Shreyas throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to deep point, who slides to his left and saves three
pick the bones out of this one! Half-way down outside off and Shedge pounces. He rises with the bounce and clatters it over deep mid wicket!
zinged in very full and wide outside off. Shedge is late on the stroke and cannot squeeze it out in time
follows up the six with a four! Low full toss outside off and that is easy pickings with mid off up. Shedge goes deep into his crease and pops it over mId off!
thumped over long on, and that is one way to face a hat-trick ball! Dug in short just outside off. Shedge sits deep in his crease and mauls it well over the fence!

two wickets in two balls, and Starc, all of a sudden, is on a hat-trick now! Full outside off. Shashank plants his front foot and swings through the line. Slices it, though, and Axar completes the catch at mid off with minimal fuss. PBKS losing their way a little in this over!

slapped straight to extra cover, and Stoinis has to go! Shortish outside off and this seems to just hold in the surface. Stoinis looks to go over the fielder but does not muster the elevation he wants. Tame chip to Tiwari in the end, and Starc, too, has a wicket now!
stand and deliver! Back of a length outside off. Shreyas picks the length early, goes back and across, and swats it over long on!
shortish outside off. Stoinis gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep point

an attempted tennis forehand, and it leads to Connolly's downfall! Slower bumper outside off and this takes an eternity to arrive. Connolly plays three strokes in his head before making contact with his fourth and actual attempt, which is something resembling a top-spin forehand in tennis. Does not get enough distance on it and Miller does the rest at deep mid wicket!
Connolly with a boundary too! Back of a length on middle and leg. Connolly gets his front hip out of the way and hoicks it to deep mid wicket's right!
into the blockhole outside off. Shreyas opens his bat face and guides it towards short third
short, wide and dispatched! A loose ball, especially at this time of the innings. Sits up and Shreyas slaps it over extra cover to bring up a 32-ball fifty in challenging conditions!
slower bumper but this just sneaks down leg. Shreyas swipes and misses, but does get the wide
right up in the blockhole on middle and off. Shreyas gets his bat down in time and clinks it out towards short third
pushed in very full outside leg. Connolly clears his front leg and drills it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Shreyas opens up his stance and tugs it to long on
full on middle and off. Connolly plants his front foot and powers it to long off
fired in very full on middle and leg. Shreyas cannot do much with it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
back of a length just outside off. Connolly tries to hit it too hard and shanks it into the on side
off-pace on a length outside off, with lots of over-spin. Shreyas goes feeling for it and the ball fizzes past the outside edge of his dangling bat
slow and dipping full toss on middle and leg. Connolly hacks it towards deep mid wicket
zipped in very full outside off. Shreyas cannot get under it and shanks it to long on
slower ball on a length just outside off. Connolly winds up for a slog before realizing this is a change-up. Adjusts late and drops it into the off side
right out of the screws this time! This is full enough again, and into the pads. Connolly gets his front foot out of the way and shovels it over wide long on!
sliced way up, and Connolly gets four! Fullish on middle and off. Connolly gives himself a bit of room and lofts it over extra cover. Bounces just before the cushion!
full on middle and off, and Connolly misses out. Laces his cover drive but also picks out extra cover in the ring
back of a length on leg and this kicks up too. Shreyas fends at it and the ball dribbles off his glove into the on side. Right on the thumb of the bottom hand
back of a length on middle and leg. Connolly tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
Connolly goes massive! What a shot this is. Back of a length outside off. Connolly stands up tall and obliterates it a mile over long off. A 96m six!
hard length again, zoning into middle and leg. Connolly has no room to work with and jams it back to the bowler
slanted in on a length on leg. Nips in further and Connolly, looking to flick it away, gets struck on the back leg, with the ball dribbling into the off side
full outside off and this leaves the batter at the last moment. Shreyas looks to go inside out but only grabs a handful of fresh mountain air
hard length on middle and off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and turns it towards deep mid wicket. Calls for two and Porel's misfield makes it a much more comfortable exercise
streaky but guess what, they all count! Dug in shorter outside off. Shreyas winds up and swipes at it, squirting it off the inside edge past the stumps!
back of a length just outside off and this kicks up a bit. Shreyas adjusts and plays it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Shreyas lets the ball come to him before prodding it back to the bowler
hard length on the stumps. Connolly stay leg side of the ball and jabs it towards sweeper cover
shot! Too much width on offer and the shortish nature of the delivery allows Shreyas to raze a square cut past backward point!
shortish again, just outside off. Connolly has a swish at it and tugs it into the on side
back of a length outside off. Shreyas rises with the bounce and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Conolly gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep point
back of a length just outside off and this skids through. Keeps a little low too and Connolly, swiping at it, is beaten for pace (and by the lack of bounce)
shortish on middle and off. Shreyas hops up onto his toes and hacks it into the square leg region
how has that missed the stumps?! Sizzling yorker, pitching just outside leg. Connolly looks to dig it out and nutmegs himself. Not far away from leg stump either
back of a length on off. Shreyas stays leg side of the ball and taps it into the off side

oh my word - that is ridiculous timing! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Shreyas is done all ends up but he somehow still reaches out in front. One handed and he caresses it over the long off fence. Ngidi cannot believe it. Not sure we can either!
back of a length on the stumps. Connolly gets squared up a little and edges it down to deep third
back of a length, angling into the hips. Shreyas uses the angle and glances it down to fine leg
hard length, pitching on off and nipping back in. Shreyas is rushed on the flick and the ball bobbles off his back thigh into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg. Connolly hangs back and pats it towards mid wicket
fired in full just outside off. Shreyas takes a step back before driving it to long on
shortish on the hips. Connolly tucks it towards deep backward square leg and keeps things ticking
back of a length outside off. Shreyas has a jab at it and edges it down to deep third
shot of the night, perhaps! On a length outside off. Shreyas gets onto the front foot, goes through the line and pops it over mid off with a straight bat!

oh wow - not sure how to describe that! Seems like a slower ball gone wrong and Tiwari nearly jams this into his own toe-nail. The ball slides down leg and barely seems to cross the crease before bouncing again. Umpires checking to see if this should be a No ball. The second bounce was just beyond the crease. Just a wide
back of a length on the pads. Connolly works it towards deep backward square leg and ambles across to the other end
hard length just outside off and this nips in a touch. Connolly wafts at it and chunks it into the on side. Wrings his left hand in pain soon after
angled in full on middle and leg. Connolly laces his straight drive but Starc gets his left boot in the way
shot! Full outside off and Connolly takes full toll. He opens his bat face and scythes it past backward point!
oh dear! This is further down leg and Rahul does really well to get his right glove to it. Just a solitary extra
full and darting down leg. Connolly does not get bat on it and the umpire has to indulge in some exercise
fullish just outside off. Connolly presses half forward and blocks
into the blockhole outside off. Shreyas jams down on it and digs it out behind point
safe! Full outside off and this seems to stick in the surface a touch. Shreyas a tad early into his lofted stroke and gets enough on it to clear mid off

skewed up, and taken! Tiwari with his maiden IPL wicket, and he has sent back the set batter! Fullish in the channel and this seems to move away with the angle. Arya looks to go inside-out and to be fair, it is there to be hit. Slices across it a little too much, though, and Parakh accepts the offering with glee at deep point. Arya walks back after an initially tone-setting knock, and DC keep chipping away!
on the shorter side again, on middle and off. Arya mows across the line and misses. Cops a blow on the back thigh for his troubles
top shot to break the shackles! Back of a length on middle and off. Arya stands up tall and nonchalantly lifts it over extra cover!
dug in short on middle and leg, and this zips through. Arya has a swipe at it and is late on the pull, with the ball whistling past his flailing blade
back of a length in the channel and this nips away a touch too. Shreyas opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
sloppy by KL Rahul, and PBKs get more bonus runs! Length ball in the channel and this shapes away late. Shreyas pokes at it and misses, and Rahul makes a meal of it too!
shorter and perhaps wider outside off. Shreyas gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
hard length, honing into middle and off. Shreyas gets behind the line of the ball and defends
four more! Back of a length in the channel and this nips away to square up Shreyas. To his credit, he plays with soft hands and ends up nurdling it past the keeper!
Shreyas is up and running now! Banged in short on middle and leg. Shreyas swivels inside the line and helps it into the fine leg fence!
safe! Full and slanted across the batter outside off. Arya throws his hands at it and slices it down to deep third
oh! Back of a length outside off, and this leaves the batter late. Shreyas goes fishing at it and sees the ball whiz past the outside edge

shanked to deep backward square leg, and Prabhsimran's troubles come to an end! Shortish and tucking up the batter on middle and leg. Prabh looks for the pick-up pull but has no room to work with. Miscues it and Nabi, diving forward on the fence, does the rest. DC on the board, finally, and it is just reward for the squeeze they have applied!
fullish on middle and leg. Arya steps forward and flicks it to long on
shortish and following the batter outside leg. Prabh, having advanced, stabs it past the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Prabh has a waft at it and seems to get beaten for pace
shortish and tailing down leg again. Prabh swipes at it and misses, but the umpire stretches out his arms again
banged in short and this slides well down leg. Prabh ducks under it and gets the wide call too
full outside off. Prabh comes forward and drives it towards deep point, where Tiwari misfields and ends up conceding the second

what a seed! Nabi unlucky to end this powerplay with zero wickets. This is on a hard length on middle and leg. Jags away sharply and Arya is squared up completely. Nibbles at it and gets beaten. Too good a ball to be nicked!
back of a length outside off, and this nips away with the angle. Arya goes wafting at it with minimal footwork and gets beaten on the outside
very full outside off. Arya jams down on it and squeezes it out towards cover point
back of a length just outside off. Prabh hangs back and drops it into the point region
another swing and a miss! Fullish on middle and off. Prabh marches down and then swings for the fences. Misses the ball by a fair distance, with the ball bouncing over the stumps
full on middle and leg. Arya pushes it neatly to mid on and brings up another blazing half-century. This one has come off 24 balls, and he has gotten PBKS off to another strong start!
edged and four! Length ball outside off. Prabh skips down the track and swishes at it wildly. Squirts it off the toe-end and it dribbles away to the keeper's right!
zipped in very full again, angling into middle and leg. Prabh jams down on it and digs it out towards the bowler
very full on the pads. Arya pushes it to mid on and hares across to the other end
back of a length on middle and off. Arya gets a half stride in and defends
back of a length in the channel and this nips back in a touch. Arya has an ungainly mow at it and misses. Another coat of pain, and off stump would have been pegged back!
this bat is working, alright! Slot ball and laced with width. Arya lets his hands flow through the ball and thumps it over extra cover!
fuller on off. Arya comes forward and turns it into the mid wicket region to keep strike

ripper! No reward yet, though. Full on middle and leg. Nips away sharply and Arya, driving at it, is beaten all ends up. Arya lucky his stumps are still intact. The extra bounce and movement saving him there
fullish outside off, shaping away again. Prabh presses forward and dabs it just behind point
fullish just outside off. Prabh gets onto the front foot and plays it back to the bowler
oh! Right in the slot on off, and this seems to shape away late. Prabh tries to hit it into the mountains and the ball zips over the stumps
that has flown to the fence! And Nabi has overstepped again - uh-oh! Back of a length outside off. Prabh waits on it and opens his bat face to glide it into the deep third fence!
back of a length on the stumps. Arya opens his bat face a tad and taps it into the point region
slower ball on a full length outside off. Prabh gets onto the front foot and drives it to mid off
into the blockhole just outside off. Arya clinks it out towards extra cover and settles for a single
just over! Slower ball hung up full and wide. Arya holds his shot long enough and then gets under it to knife it over backward point!
dipping slower yorker on middle and off. Arya spots it just in time and plays it back to the bowler
pace-on, and this is glorious, glorious batting! Full enough outside off and Arya says thank you very much. He presses forward, shows the maker's name and creams it over the wide long off fence!
and Ngidi travels too! A touch short just outside off and this sits up. Arya stands up tall and pounds it over mid on!
fullish on middle and leg. Arya plonks it towards mid off and eases across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Prabh hangs back and jabs it towards deep backward point
length just outside off. Arya drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end

another high ball, and the catch is dropped too, for what it is worth! Full on middle and leg. Arya goes through the line but checks his swing. Axar, running back, lets it drop to the turf. No attempt at all, which kind of makes sense with the catch not counting
beauty! This is the length Nabi should be bowling, especially with movement on offer. On a length outside off and Arya, feeling for it, is beaten on the outside. But hang on. Nabi has overstepped...
shoveled a mile up, and it is long enough, again! Marginally short on middle and leg. Arya picks it up and dumps it over the deep mid wicket fence!
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this continues with the angle. Arya plays for the ball shaping in and is beaten on the outside
Prabh off the mark in style too! This is over-pitched outside off and not a great deal of swing either. Prabh presses forward and with a slightly open bat face, drills it through cover!
full and wide outside off, shaping away further. Arya opens his bat face and slices it down to deep backward point

going, going, gone! Slanted in on a length on leg. Arya plants his front foot and launches it a mile up. The ball comes down with snow on it and lands just beyond a leaping Stubbs at deep backward square leg!
oh dear - more runs! Banged in short outside off and this sails over the batter's head. Arya swipes and misses, and Rahul needed a step-ladder to get to that!
zipped in full on the pads. Arya nearly falls across but does enough to flick it towards mid wicket
hard length on middle and leg. Arya gets up on his toes and defends. He got a little squared up there
up and over first ball! Arya does not care one bit! Starc with the new ball. Starc with an out-swinger outside off. But Arya does not flinch. Throws his hands at it and carves it over deep point!

a stirring blow over the bowler's head, and the Capitals are alive! Eight teams remain in contention for four spots, with the Punjab Kings, once table-toppers, now consigned to their fourth successive defeat! Full toss outside off and Nabi cannot believe his luck. He sits deep in his crease and smokes it over long off. Excellent, excellent cameo by Nabi, and a brilliant run-chase overall by the Capitals, and while their road to the playoffs is still tough, they remain afloat, and still in with something resembling a shout!

a high full toss, and a No ball has been called! Nabi bashes it into the fence too, and DC are almost there! Full toss near the hips. Nabi uses the pace and whips it away behind square. Wheels coming off for PBKS now, and the scores are level!

in the air, in the air, and taken! And this game turns yet again! This is banged half-way down and wide outside off. Ashutosh tries to fight the line this time rather than using it, and pays the price. Tries to fetch it and skies his swat. Dubey, on as a sub, runs to his right from long on and snares it. Ashutosh not happy with himself. His cameo has put DC on the verge of a win, but someone else will have to take them past the finish line!

short, wide and this flies too! DC running riot, and running rampant now! Too much pace on offer and this becomes a safe shot because of it. Ashutosh throws the lot at it and carves it over deep third!
dug in short outside off. Tiwari has a huge swipe at it and shanks it towards mid wicket
my goodness - what a shot this is! Misses the wide yorker on the shorter side. Tiwari jams down on it and he pings it between deep point and short third!
banged in short outside off and this skips through. Tiwari goes back and across, and mows at it, but gets beaten for pace
hard length, zoning into leg. Tiwari backs away and stabs at it, squirting it off the inside edge behind square
Tiwari swings for the hills, and musters just enough mustard to clear the fence! In the slot just outside off. Tiwari has a good'ol swipe at it and muscles it over deep backward square leg!
back of a length outside off. Ashutosh sits back in his crease and pokes it to the bowler's left
this is an incredible shot! Back of a length on middle and leg. Ashutosh skips inside the line and helps it well over the fine leg fence!
another stunning blow! Half-tracker outside off and this is fodder for Ashutosh. He winds up and biffs it to long on's right!
shortish just outside off. Tiwari hangs back and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
fullish and hung up outside off. Ashutosh hares down and tries to smash it into next week. Makes no contact whatsoever
back of a length on middle and off. Tiwari works it towards deep mid wicket and keeps things ticking
oh, hello! Where have you been, Madhav Tiwari?! Back of a length outside off. Tiwari walks across his stumps, rolls his wrists and steers it past backward point!

oh my - this has gone so far up. Comes down with rain on it, and Prabhsimran lunges forward to snaffle it up! Hard length just outside off. Miller opens up his stance and swipes across the line. Gets a massive leading edge and the ball swirls for an eternity. Prabhsimran calls early, runs forward and then dives to complete the catch in the short extra cover region. Miller is livid with himself, but this is a massive moment in the game!

fetch this one too, says David Miller! In the arc, and out of the park. Slot ball on off and Miller winds up to pump this over long on. A 27-ball fifty to keep his team alive - tonight, and in the comp!
oh my days - Miller is in the mood! Slower short ball outside off. Sits up without venom and Miller leaps up into the air to slap it over long off!

another edge, and another boundary! DC will not care an iota, though. On a length on off. Ashutosh throws the plumbing at it and skews it enough to Chahal's right at deep third. Chahal put in a dive but it was in vain!
zipped in full on middle and leg. Miller plants his front foot and flicks it to long on
another flat six, and Miller is turning it on! Another short ball on leg but this too sits up. Miller swivels on it well and plunders it over deep backward square leg!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Miller has a waft at it and gets beaten on the inside this time
that has been butchered! Half-tracker outside off and Miller has all the time in the world to thump it into the deep mid wicket fence!
back of a length outside off. Miller swings like a rusty gate and only swats away a few flies in the process
shortish outside off. Miller gets up on his toes and pulls it towards long on
length ball outside off. Miller has a wild whoosh across the line and misses it completely. Miller lost his shape and could get nowhere near it
back of a length on off. Ashutosh opens his bat face and nudges it into the point region
oh! Back of a length in the sixth stump channel. Ashutosh goes feeling for it and sees the ball whiz past the outside edge
back of a length on off. Ashutosh has a poke at it and chunks it off the inside edge behind square. Has enough time to get back for a brace
slanted in on a length on leg. Miller backs away and tucks it towards deep mid wicket

clothed off the toe-end, and Stoinis breaks through! Slower ball on a full length on off. Axar's eyes light up but he is too early into his swing. Right off the bottom part of the bat and Dwarshuis, settling under it at long on, makes no mistake. Big, big moment in the game!
off the outside edge, and beyond short third! Back of a length outside off. Axar throws the kitchen sink at it and slashes it over Chahal!
four more - and Axar brings up his first half century of the season! Stoinis misses the leg stump yorker on the shorter side. Axar clears his front leg and muscles it to long on's left!
right in the gap! Shortish and sitting up near the hips. Axar swivels and hoicks it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
slower short ball outside off. Axar tries to reach out but fails to do so. Called a wide again
hard length on middle and off. Axar cannot do much with it and defends
full ball sliding down leg. Axar does not make contact with his flick this time but does get the wide
back of a length on middle and off. Axar arches his back and looks for the upper-cut but does not make contact
slower ball on a length on middle and leg. Axar bunts it enough to the bowler's left and keeps strike
slower ball on a back of a length on middle and off. Miller punches it to long on
full on middle and leg. Axar flicks it to deep mid wicket
oh dear - more easy runs for DC! Bumper outside off and this hurtles over the batter's head. The keeper cannot get to it either, and DC get five runs!
back of a length just outside off. Axar hangs back and runs it dabs it into the deep third region. Dwarshuis has to sprawl to his left to stop it
banged in short outside off. Axar shuffles across, trying to lap it away but misses. Called one bouncer for the over
back of a length on middle and off. Miller drops it just behind the stumps (and towards the keeper) for a sharp single
Axar goes big again, and DC are right in this now! BAck of a length outside off. Axar spots the length really early and deposits it over deep mid wicket!
shortish just outside off. Miller has a hack at it and drags it towards deep square leg
back of a length outside off. Axar hangs back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
slower short ball outside off. Miller waits for it before swiping it to deep mid wicket
superb batting! Dragged down outside off. Miller hops up onto his toes and slaps it past extra cover. Miller playing the field nicely now!
safe! Back of a length outside off. Miller hares down and throws the kitchen sink at it. Slices it but gets it over backward point. Shedge slides in and slips, but does enough to stop the boundary
back of a length on the pads. Miller eases it out to deep square leg
back of a length on the pads. Axar tucks it towards deep square leg
back of a length on leg. Miller hops up onto his toes and helps it behind square
fetch that, says Miller! Half-tracker outside leg. Miller steps outside leg further, opens up his stance and thunders a pull over mid wicket. Flat six!
back of a length on the pads. Axar taps it enough to mid wicket's left for a single
full ball on the pads. Miller nudges it into the square leg region and keeps things ticking
back of a length outside off. Miller gets up on his toes and jabs it towards sweeper cover
hard length, angling into middle and leg. Axar uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
more runs to fine leg! This is not great bowling. Full and down leg, and Axar helps himself to another easy boundary!
back of a length outside off. Miller gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep point
pushed in full on the pads. Miller misses his flick this time and the ball kisses the pad before being collected by the keeper
first boundary for Miller! Full ball on the pads and Miller puts it away. Rolls his wrists and clips it behind square. A valiant effort on the fence, but in vain!
short outside off. Miller gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards deep point to open his account
back of a length just outside off. Miller gets squared up a little and prods it towards backward point
back of a length just outside off. Miller gets up on his toes and defends
did that carry?! Full and sliding into the pads. Axar flicks it uppishly and picks out deep square. Shedge runs in, dives forward but shells it

huge mix-up, and Stubbs has been run-out! Axar distraught, and the Punjab Kings are delighted! Back of a length on middle and off. Axar seems to jam it off the inside edge, with the ball then rolling towards Connolly at backward point. Stubbs hares down, only to be sent back by his skipper, who, by the way, did not move a muscle. Connolly's throw is right on point and Stubbs, despite a dive, is caught well short. PBKS with a timely breakthrough!
full on middle and leg. Stubbs plants his front foot and powers it on the bounce to long on. Good work by Arshdeep to his left
clever batting! Banged in short on middle and leg, and this is a response to Axar advancing. Axar adjusts, though, and upper-cuts it over the keeper!
back of a length in the channel and this is an action replay of the previous ball. Axar looks to dab at it but is beaten
back of a length outside off and this bounces steeply. Axar looks to dab it behind point and is beaten by the extra lift
back of a length outside off. Stubbs fences at it and chops it off the under-edge towards the keeper
back of a length on middle and leg. Axar happy to help it down to fine leg
what timing! Back of a length just outside off. Axar waits on it and opens his bat face late to glide it beautifully past backward point!
fullish on leg. Stubbs gets a half stride in before prodding it back to the bowler
shortish and sneaking down leg again. Axar misses and Prabh fumbles diving to his right yet again. PBKS leaking runs now
another brilliant shot! On a length outside off. Axar marches down the track again and pummels it over mid off!
four more! Shortish and drifting into the pads. Axar gets inside the line early and tickles it fine past the keeper!
miscued, and Arshdeep puts down a sitter! Hard length on leg. Stubbs looks to go downtown and shanks it. Arshdeep runs in from long on and shells a very presentable chance!
zipped in full on middle and off. Driven down the ground to long on
another fumble by the keeper, and more bonus runs for DC. Back of a length, tailing down leg. Axar misses it and Prabh manages to nutmeg himself
back of a length on the pads. Stubbs glances it down to fine leg
banged in short on middle and leg, and this climbs through. Axar ducks under it with his bat sticking out like a periscope, and is lucky the ball misses his bat
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs jams it off the inside edge into his body, and the ball rolls away towards slip
shortish on middle and off. Stubbs jumps up onto his toes and pushes it towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Axar has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside edge into the on side
shot! Length ball, slanting into middle and off. Axar dances down the track and thumps it over the bowler's head!
back of a length delivery sneaking down leg. Axar misses it and the ball wobbles late, which Prabhsimran adjusts to
length ball in the channel and this curves away late. Axar has a waft at it and is beaten comprehensively on the outside
back of a length, honing into off. Stubbs lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs gets up on his toes and defends
length ball speared well down leg. This time, the keeper gets more of a glove to it and diverts it towards long leg
fullish and swinging into the pads. Stubbs tucks it towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery sliding down leg. Axar does not get bat on it and the keeper only gets a bit of a glove to it. Couple of extras

cramped for room, and Parakh is outta here! Banged in short and this seems to be a riposte to the batter advancing. Angling into leg stump too, meaning Parakh is tucked up completely. Tries to dab it away but cannot keep it down. Arrows it to short third, where Chahal lunges forward and gobbles it up, despite a slight bobble. DC three down inside five overs!
dragged down on leg. Stubbs gets onto the back foot and hacks it towards deep square leg
full ball, in and around off. Stubbs comes onto the front foot and punches it straight to mid off
gorgeous! Fullish outside off and Parakh pulls off another special stroke. Stands still and carves it over cover. One bounce and into the fence!
back of a length on off. Parakh opens his bat face and guides it past short third. Back for a couple of runs
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs has a stab at it and plonks it off the leading edge towards deep backward point
shot! Back of a length outside off. Stubbs rises with the bounce and cracks it through cover. Hit it into the turf and the ball bounced up through the gap!
dug in short on middle and leg. Parakh, having advanced, stays leg side of the ball and dabs it towards backward point
oh, hello! First six in IPL cricket, and it is a thunderous blow! Full outside off. Parakh gets onto the front foot, shows the full face of the bat and slams it over mid off!
full and shaping away outside off. Stubbs goes chasing after it away from his body and is beaten on the outside
fullish just outside off. Stubbs gets a better stride in and blocks it towards mid off
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs presses half forward and pats it gently into the off side

goes straight up, and Jansen snares the chance! Hard length on middle and leg, and this stands up a touch. Rahul looks to swivel and help it on its way but the ball skews off the top edge. Prabhsimran runs back, as does Jansen, but Jansen calls loudly enough in the end to overtake Prabhsiram and take the catch diving low to his left. Top grab, and DC in trouble early!
edged and four! Length ball, slanting across the batter just outside off. Rahul has a wild swing at it and the ball flies off the outside edge over slip!
oh! Length ball just outside off. Rahul looks to tonk it into tomorrow and misses it completely
back of a length outside off. Parakh hops around his crease before dropping it into the off side

middle stump out of the ground, and the change in angle has worked a charm! Slanted in on a length in the channel, bowled at 143.kph. Jags back in with the angle and Porel, looking to drive on the up, is all at sea. Misses it completely and sees his middle stump in a mess soon after. First over this season for Yash but he has not missed a beat!
off the glove and into the fence! Short and tucking up the batter just outside leg. Porel is late on the pull but the ball grazes enough of the glove to roll away past the keeper!
full outside off. Porel plants his front foot and scuffs it towards mid off. Pace going up for Yash - this was bowled at 143.3kph
back of a length just outside off. Porel gets up on his toes and defends. This was bowled at 143.2kph
pushed across on a length outside off. Porel goes wafting at it and seems the ball whiz past the outside edge. That was bowled at 136.7kph
full and swinging into the pads. Rahul presses forward and pokes it down the ground
beauty! Back of a length in the channel and this threatens to shape in. On pitching, though, it holds its line and Rahul is beaten all ends up!
short and wide outside off, swinging away further. Porel throws his hands at it and cuts it on the bounce to deep backward point
back of a length just outside off. Rahul gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side for a quick single
another out-swinger, on a length outside off. Rahul walks down the track before nibbling at it. A bit of an outside edge and Chahal misfields at short third to let in four!
out-swinger first up, starting full on leg and finishing on middle. Rahul comes onto the front foot and defends
